Class RadioButtonsTag

org.springframework.web.servlet.tags.form.RadioButtonsTag
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.DynamicAttributes, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag, jakarta.servlet.jsp.tagext.TryCatchFinally, Serializable, EditorAwareTag
public class RadioButtonsTag extends AbstractMultiCheckedElementTag
The <radiobuttons> tag renders multiple HTML 'input' tags with type 'radio'.

渲染的元素在配置的 value 与绑定值匹配时，会被标记为“已选中”。
